issues.message: The "How It Works" page failed the web performance test. It is essential to investigate the cause of this failure and optimize the page for better performance. Recommendation
issues.recommendation: Review server logs, error messages, and resource usage during the test to identify bottlenecks and areas for improvement.

insights: The homepage has a load time of 625.3 ms, TTFB of 71.9 ms, and FCP of 438.9 ms. This indicates that the homepage loads quickly, but there is still room for improvement in reducing TTFB and FCP.
The pricing page has a load time of 344.8 ms, TTFB of 208 ms, and FCP of 375.9 ms. This shows that the pricing page loads faster than the homepage, but TTFB could be further optimized.

The blog page has the fastest load time of 274.6 ms, TTFB of 57.4 ms, and FCP of 206.7 ms. This suggests that the blog page is well-optimized and could serve as a benchmark for optimizing other pages.

To improve the performance of the "How It Works" page, consider optimizing images, minifying CSS and JavaScript, leveraging browser caching, and reducing HTTP requests. Additionally, ensure that the server is properly configured and has sufficient resources to handle the page's requirements.
